data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 50 fishers × 10 = 500 tons caught, leaving 500, so either replenishment outcome restores the lake to 1000. That yields each of us $10,000 monthly without risking future income. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; catches revealed afterward can guide future cooperation.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month: 50 × 10 = 500 tons caught, leaving 500, so next month's stock returns to 1,000 under either replenishment outcome. That gives each of us $10,000 monthly without risking the fishery. I intend to request 10 tons if this plan gains broad support. Please state whether you support it; we can review revealed catches afterward.

I propose a renewable quota: each requests 18 tons when stock is 1,000, and 2 tons when stock is 200. If everyone follows it, 100 tons remain; next month starts at either 1,000 or 200, never collapsing. This averages 14 tons per person per month, versus 10 under a fixed 10-ton plan, and leaves a 50-ton safety buffer above collapse. I intend to follow this plan and invite your responses.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and each month stock is 1000. If all 50 comply, 500 remain and replenishment restores 1000 under either outcome, yielding each of us $10,000/month indefinitely. A larger one-time haul risks losing that continuing income. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to do the same; no agreement is assumed.

I propose 10 tons each this month. If all 50 follow, 500 tons remain and stock returns to 1,000 under either replenishment outcome—supporting $10,000 each every month indefinitely. In future months, cap individual requests at floor(current stock/100). I intend to request 10; please state whether you support this sustainable equal-share plan.
